segments.section: A The simple past with regular verbs

segments.text: When did Sam stay at home?
segments.instructions: Ask a neutral information question with a gentle falling finish.
segments.section: A The simple past with regular verbs

segments.text: Was it yesterday?
segments.instructions: Ask a genuine question with a gentle natural rise.
segments.section: A The simple past with regular verbs

segments.text: No, he didn't stay at home yesterday. He stayed at home the day before yesterday.
